messages:
ana: weird packing behavior today, eu-west1 nodes look half-full but scheduler can't place small GPU pods, pending up ~60 :eyes:
tom: I think it's the tiny-pod overflow + rack-level taints. saw many pods requiring gpu:1 but scheduler prefers big-gang placement, ends up leaving 2 GPUs unused per node
jess: eviction spikes too?
tom: yes, observed repeated evict/reharmonize loops on nodes with nvlink groups -> scheduler keeps moving tiny pods to respect NVLINK affinity, then backfills larger pods and re-evicts :facepalm:
sre-bot: ALERT: cluster=eu-west1 condition=packing_efficiency<0.6 pending_small_pods>50
mike: logs show pod scoring weight for nvlink_family is 20, and small-pod penalty for fragmentation is 15, so small pods lose out. also we have mixed instance types (reserved + spot) causing fractional free GPUs across nodes
ana: (typo) ana meant to say^
ana: proposed quick mitigation: reduce nvlink_family weight to 8 temporarily and relax "strictGangAffinity" for tiny pods via a feature flag
tom: can we instead run a binpack-defrag job that consolidates small pods onto fewer nodes and frees contiguous GPUs for big jobs?
jess: defrag sounds better long-term. short-term policy flip to favor small-pod coalescing so user-facing pipelines don't time out
mike: manual commands I used: 
```
kubectl annotate node node-42 infra/binpack-defrag=disabled
./tools/binpack-defrag --region eu-west1 --consolidate --dry-run
```
ana: ran dry-run, estimated reclaimed 28 GPUs if we consolidate small pods; running live with --apply in 10m
sre-bot: NOTE: autoscaler will notice consolidation and may scale-down nodes; set scale-disable flag to avoid oscillation
tom: set scale-disable: `kubectl patch cm autoscaler-config -n infra -p '{"data":{"scale_disabled":"true"}}'`
jess: cost note: conservative consolidation may let us scale down ~6 nodes, saving ~2.4 hours worth of reserved cost over night, but risk of preempting spot jobs higher
mike: rolling defrag live: `./tools/binpack-defrag --region eu-west1 --consolidate --apply --max-move 80`
ana: moved 46 small pods, reclaimed 24 GPUs, pending small pods dropped to 9
tom: scheduler metrics look happier: packing_efficiency -> 0.78, preemptions down 40%
jess: add follow-ups: add a scheduler scoring test for mixed-instance topologies, add metric "small_pod_starvation_total", and revisit nvlink_family weight heuristics in 2.6.0
ana: will open issues and a short postmortem. tagging @sre-oncall if this regresses. thanks team :thumbsup:
